title: Software Engineering
standfirst: How real software is planned, built and maintained by teams — requirements, design, version control, testing, delivery.
instructor: Prof. Sridhar Iyer & Dr. Prajish Prasad

description_paragraphs: This course develops essential software engineering skills by introducing fundamental concepts and practices, including requirements gathering, conceptual design, software comprehension, debugging, testing, and deployment.

In-course project: The in-course project is integrated into the course and not offered separately. Students work in teams that simulate real-world IT environments, addressing client requirements (typically set by a TA or instructor) and following industry-standard software development practices. The final product is presented before a panel that includes TAs and instructors. An example of a previous project : AI Agent for Academic Guidance
faculty: Prof. Sridhar Iyer, Interdisciplinary Program in Educational Technology, IIT Bombay
Dr. Prajish Prasad, Department of Computer Science, FLAME University

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Software development lifecycle - requirements, design, testing; Models (Waterfall, Agile); Components; Project context.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Requirements engineering - gathering, SRS; Functional/non-functional requirements; User stories.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: UI/UX design - interaction, usability; Prototyping; Heuristic evaluation.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Project management - estimation, scheduling, risk; Agile; Tools.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Software design - modularity, OOP; UML; Design tools.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Development practices - APIs, version control; Code quality (debugging, metrics, clean code); Collaboration.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Software architecture; SOLID principles; Design patterns (creational, structural).

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Software testing - unit, integration, system; Black-box/white-box; TDD.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Deployment environments and strategies; Hosting platforms (IaaS, PaaS); Continuous integration; Performance monitoring.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Software organizations; Collaboration and productivity; Software engineering skills.
